title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text: 7. Considers initiatives regarding individual restrictive measures or sanctions to be a tool of unjustified foreign interference and political pressure; calls for the EU and the Member States to prioritise constructive dialogue and mutual respect over unilateral actions that lead to increased polarisation and harm the long-term relationship between the EU and Georgia;
